name: TL-118 "StarHammer" Short-range Attack Ship
description: The TL-118 "StarHammer" Short-range Attack Ship was a heavy assault starfighter manufactured by Subpro Corporation. It was 35 meters long, it carried 1 pilot, 1 gunner, and 1 week's worth of consumables.
